### Power Supply - Phased out / LEADEX II Gold 850W

##### Products Name : LEADEX II Gold 850W

 

### Features

LEADEX II series PSU are 80PLUS 115V & 230V EU dual certified with 100% fully modular cable design, our R&D team's latest innovation, a brilliant idea to maximize PSU cables & connectors management to have the best cable routing solution, also increase case chassis air flow to have best cooling for your system. LEADEX II series PSU provides high efficiency & stable power output and come with a 13.5cm two-way thermal control intelligent cooling fan to ensure your professional PC system will work under heavy load, also capable of powering your PC system equipped with NVIDIA® SLI™ or ATI CrossFireX™ setup.

Highlights:
### 電源供應器 - LEADEX GOLD / LEADEX Gold 650W

##### Products Name : LEADEX Gold 650W

 

### 產品特色

振華電腦全球首度量產，通過80+金牌認證的全模組化設計之電源供應器─LEADEX GOLD-650W，超值的規格以及節能環保的概念，開賣後屢創銷售佳績。為了生產最高品質的產品，振華採用最頂級的用料，包含日系NIPPON CHEMI-CON的高壓大電容與低壓小電容；而全模組化設計的專利水晶接頭可提供多樣化彈性選擇，全面強化線材配置管理，並且有效降低電壓耗損，提升電源效率。再加上過負載護OPP、過電壓保護OVP與短路保護SCP，讓振華的電源供應器在使用上更加穩定可靠。除了頂級用料之外，振華LEADEX更擁有ECO智慧節能溫控系統以及HPT高功率立式雙層主變壓器等獨家專利。振華隆重推出的全模組LEADEX，提供五年免費保固與1000天免費到府收送，讓消費者能安心使用。設計及效能超群的LEADEX，絕對是玩家級消費者的頂級首選。
